scope: Source-code contracts and primary provider documentation; no claim of live production execution.

pricing.note: Read source: public price catalog uses minor units; Stripe portal is per authenticated customer. No paid actions executed.

teams.note: Read owner/member gates and actual role constants; invite URLs are owner-visible capabilities.

regions.note: Read region-list and region-by-ID handlers. Runtime catalog rather than a hard-coded location list.

api-contract.note: Current tracked client schema and router mounts, not a live endpoint probe; full internal schema is not republished.
api-contract.deployment_review_note: The source fingerprint changed during infrastructure verification. All 163 selected public operation records were compared and are unchanged; only the source fingerprint was refreshed. No unselected source bytes were copied.

lifecycle.note: Read status enums and public operation contracts; no customer state changed.

api-auth.note: Read API key session-auth gates, MFA setup/enable sequence, account routes and password form; no credentials created.

account-ui.note: Read current account, profile and password/MFA surfaces; no account mutations.

referrals.note: Referrals and recorded payouts are present; no verified basis for old fixed incentive, eligibility or expiry amounts.

stripe-portal.note: Official portal capabilities; actual SiteBay portal configuration and provider UI determine available actions.

mcp-platform.note: Read the in-process transport, advertised tool generation and intent implementations; source-supported, not a live MCP qualification.

git-sync.note: Read repository-layout validation, provider-independent state and executor outcome semantics.

code-server.note: Read code-server SSO grants, bridge config and managed workspace path; official extension-gallery behavior.

platform-architecture.note: Control-plane model and source-visible deployment boundaries; does not promise a fixed fleet layout, capacity or region.

shell-reference.note: Shell syntax checked with disposable fixtures; platform paths come from code-server source. Shell implementations and privileges must be checked in the current environment.

wp-cli.note: Official WP-CLI command contracts; documentation examples are not executed against a customer database.

wp-config.note: Read simple-literal allowlist and structured rejections; no customer configuration changed.

site-ui.note: Read current tab labels, access gates, one-use WP admin grant, activity and restore controls; no live site actions.

cloudflare-cache.note: Official cache scope and purge-result verification; provider controls depend on the site connection.

templates.note: Current ready-made catalog and authoring handlers, not a live catalog inventory.

shopify.note: Read linked-store ownership and OAuth side effects; connection is not automatic storefront redirection or catalog replication.

wp-theme.note: Source theme e606c0b; parent versus child and actual generated tokens. Installed customer version must be inspected.

shopify-theme.note: Theme e604a2f configuration and section contract. Do not assume WordPress token defaults equal Shopify defaults.

wp-agent-plugin.note: Current plugin repository documents Sorti Agent Plugin naming, permissioned field/variant surfaces and optional MCP adapter. Not proof a customer has deployed it.

docs-style.note: Repository editorial and attribution conventions; user requests one direct, task-oriented style.

analytics-ui.note: Current SiteBay PostHog frontend capabilities. Instructions describe feature areas without inventing an exact navigation hierarchy or enabling settings on a live project.

avatar-contract.note: Canonical manifest tiers and current license-gated import flow, not the former marketing badges.

voice-runtime.note: Provider metadata is separate from speech configuration. Selected clones are validated; failed validation can select the configured fallback.

editor-bridge.note: Exact extension command and setting names from the checked-out manifest. Installation instructions do not assert marketplace release availability.

sorti-panels.note: First-party panel identity, runtime, registry and user-turn contract.

sorti-canvas.note: Provider-selected canvas backends, targets, revision checks and journal state.

sorti-runtime.note: Session context, tool actions and event delivery, not a claim that all deployments enable every tool.
sorti-runtime.completion_note: Rechecked the current turn-loop delta on 2026-10-08: owned-mission shutdown and settlement cleanup; documented session, authorization, and result semantics remain applicable.

sorti-byo.note: BYO schema and executable conformance checks.

sorti-forge.note: Current canonical authoring skill, preserved in the generated reference.

sorti-hooks.note: One session hook bus and named-channel dispatch; no universal webhook ingestion guarantee.

sts2-engine.note: Current independent MCP code app, not the obsolete local-mod relay; no artwork redistribution or live-game acceptance asserted.

wp-security.note: Upstream hardening and incident-recovery guidance; no guarantee of a malware-free site.

vulnerability-scan.note: Paid-plan gate, authenticated start/status/history and plugin remediation; no live scans performed.

student-offers.note: Official live catalog checked during refresh. No fixed credit amount or renewal eligibility is promised by this guide.

startup-offers.note: Official program routes and eligibility distinctions; advertised maximums are not awards and are deliberately not copied into a stale price table.

azure-models.note: Model availability, deployment type and supported capabilities belong to the current provider catalog, not an old benchmark table.

wp-basics.note: WordPress content structure and plugin development; screen labels depend on editor and theme.

wp-cli-inspect.note: Exact commands and scope, with explicit WordPress target and no real customer operations executed.

database-basics.note: Database roles and WordPress compatibility, not a promise that arbitrary engines can be installed on a managed site.

algolia.note: Hosted indexing and search, separate write/search keys, and asynchronous indexing. No hosted service installed by an apt command.

wp-migration.note: Files/database migration, content-export limits, and importer overwrite behavior. DNS and provider setup are separate steps.

support.note: Authenticated ticket flow and visible distinction between automated replies and human responses; no support-time guarantee.

grafana.note: SiteBay OAuth integration and dashboard interpretation; availability depends on the deployed account configuration.

password-policy.note: Current password validator: minimum 12, uppercase/lowercase/digit/approved punctuation and further pattern checks; no claim MFA challenges are enabled.

cloudflare-dns.note: DNS resolution, cache purging and current email-service guidance; no copied MX values or invented automatic mail setup.

web-protocol.note: Request semantics and precise worker-src fallback, with a narrow policy example rather than disabling CSP.

open-source.note: License-defined rights and WordPress licensing; not individualized legal advice or a claim that all media shares the code license.

inpainting-original.note: Original RoiD1kan contribution, explicitly a v1.7.0-era personal workflow; retained attribution and illustrative assets, not a current model benchmark.

inpainting.note: Current mask-based editing concepts and exact soft-inpainting controls. No image generation or claimed new benchmark performed during this documentation refresh.

playwright-mcp.note: Current official MCP configuration and extension mode from repository README; browser sharing grants access to the selected running session.

mobile-app.note: Native/web configuration exists. This does not verify store listing, signing, installation, universal links or release availability.

docs-knowledge.note: Implementation in this review branch; reference retrieval is separate from operator imports and deployment.
docs-knowledge.completion_note: Validated metadata/source identity, complete database snapshots, original line citations, and curated task-query regressions. These do not establish live model relevance.
docs-knowledge.deployment_note: Expected corpus pin, explicit container bind, readiness checks and allowlisted image context validated separately from live activation.

mcp-standard.note: Protocol transport contract; SDK handles stdio and Streamable HTTP.

pgvector-primary.note: Primary pgvector/PostgreSQL references; database mechanics and model relevance are separate checks.

ollama-embeddings.note: Explicit embedding adapter; no model is downloaded by the service.

linode-upstream.note: Original references at the pinned revision, not rebranded article copies.

sorti-current-core.note: Current mission states, observability and attempt-specific controls; product rename confirmed by the owner. This is source review, not a live deployment claim.

sorti-current-skills.note: Current shared skill navigation, revision conflict handling, read-only fallback and agent skill reads.

sorti-current-app.note: Current SiteBay site app identifiers, state and legal-action reads, recovery availability, and separate optional OAuth configuration. No backend change or live activation.

sorti-current-signals.note: Signal channels and subscription behavior retained through the product rename.

docs-infrastructure.note: Isolated Pulumi project. Locally tested definition, not a live cluster deployment.

path_convention: Paths start with a source repository name, not a host home directory. The sitebay/docs prefix names this GitHub repository. Revisions pin separately cloned or historical inputs.
